title: Spinach yogurt rice
why: Spinach wilts fast, and yogurt makes the rice a full dinner.
steps: Rinse the spinach and chop it.
Warm the oil, soften the garlic, then add the spinach and a pinch of salt until it wilts.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the yogurt.
Spoon it over the warm rice and eat.

title: Cucumber yogurt
why: Cucumber and yogurt need no heat.
steps: Chop the cucumber.
Stir it into the yogurt with a pinch of salt.
Squeeze the lemon over the top.
Eat it cold.

title: Yogurt rice
why: Warm rice and cold yogurt is enough.
steps: Warm the rice if it is cold.
Stir the yogurt through the rice with a pinch of salt.
Loosen it with a spoon of water if it looks stiff.
Eat it cool or just warm.

title: Tomato cucumber salad
why: Tomato and cucumber, with lemon and oil, is a plate on its own.
steps: Chop the tomato and the cucumber.
Toss them with the oil and a pinch of salt.
Squeeze the lemon over them.
Eat it right away.

title: Lemon rice
why: Lemon and ginger wake up rice that is already cooked.
steps: Warm the oil and the ginger in a pan.
Add the rice and a pinch of salt and stir until hot.
Take it off the heat and stir in the lemon.
Eat it while it is warm.

title: Tomato rice
why: Onion, garlic, and tomato turn rice into a meal.
steps: Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice until it is hot.
Eat it from the pan.

title: Garlic spinach
why: Spinach and garlic cook in one pan.
steps: Rinse the spinach.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the spinach and a pinch of salt and cook until it wilts.
Eat it straight from the pan.

title: Paneer spinach
why: Paneer and spinach are done as soon as the tomato softens.
steps: Cube the paneer.
Warm the oil, soften the garlic, and add the tomato with a pinch of salt.
Add the spinach and cook until it wilts.
Stir in the paneer until it is hot, then eat.

title: Paneer tomato
why: Paneer only needs a soft tomato and onion.
steps: Cube the paneer.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the ginger.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Stir in the paneer until hot, then eat.

title: Potato tomato
why: Potato and tomato, with onion and garlic, is a pot dinner.
steps: Cut the potato into small pieces and boil it in water with a pinch of salt until tender.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Stir the potato through and eat.

title: Spinach lentils
why: Lentils and spinach share one pot, then meet the rice.
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer them in water with a pinch of salt until soft.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Add the spinach and cook until it wilts, then stir it into the lentils.
Eat it with the rice.

title: Chickpea salad
why: Chickpeas, tomato, cucumber, onion, and lemon. No stove.
steps: Rinse the chickpeas.
Chop the tomato, the cucumber, and the onion.
Toss everything with the oil, the lemon, and a pinch of salt.
Eat it cold.

title: Cauliflower with ginger
why: Small cauliflower pieces cook quickly with garlic and ginger.
steps: Cut the cauliflower into small pieces.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic and the ginger.
Add the cauliflower and a pinch of salt and cook until tender.
Eat it hot.

title: Carrot and cabbage
why: Thin carrot and cabbage soften in a few minutes with garlic.
steps: Slice the carrot and the cabbage thin.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the carrot and the cabbage with a pinch of salt and cook until just soft.
Eat it hot.

title: Potato and capsicum
why: Potato and capsicum with onion and garlic.
steps: Cut the potato small and boil it in water with a pinch of salt until tender.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Add the capsicum and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Stir the potato through and eat.

title: Peanut lemon rice
why: Peanuts and lemon make plain rice taste like you meant it.
steps: Warm the oil and stir the peanuts for about a minute.
Add the rice and a pinch of salt and heat it through.
Take it off the heat and stir in the lemon.
Eat it warm.

title: Egg rice
why: Eggs, onion, and garlic scrambled through rice.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Cook the eggs in the pan, then stir in the rice until hot.
Eat it from the pan.

title: Tomato and egg
why: Eggs and tomato, with onion, set in one pan.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Chop the tomato and the onion and stir them into the eggs.
Warm the oil and cook the eggs until just set.
Fold the eggs and eat.

title: Egg toast
why: Eggs on toast with tomato and butter.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Warm the butter and cook the eggs in it.
Toast the bread.
Put the eggs and the sliced tomato on the toast and eat.

title: Chicken rice
why: Small pieces of chicken with onion, garlic, and rice.
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Cook the chicken with a pinch of salt and a splash of water until the center is no longer pink.
Stir in the warm rice and eat.

title: Shrimp with lemon
why: Shrimp, garlic, and lemon over rice.
steps: Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the shrimp and a pinch of salt and cook until they turn pink.
Squeeze the lemon over them.
Eat with the warm rice.

title: Fish and tomato
why: Fish cooks in tomato, garlic, and lemon.
steps: Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Lay the fish in the pan and cook until it flakes.
Squeeze the lemon over it and eat.

title: Tofu spinach
why: Tofu and spinach need only garlic and oil.
steps: Cut the tofu into cubes.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the spinach and a pinch of salt and cook until it wilts.
Stir in the tofu until hot and eat.

title: Mushroom and onion
why: Mushroom and onion with garlic.
steps: Slice the mushrooms.
Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Add the mushrooms and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Eat it hot.

title: Cilantro rice
why: Cilantro and lemon stirred through rice.
steps: Chop the cilantro.
Warm the oil, then stir in the rice and a pinch of salt.
Take it off the heat and stir in the cilantro and the lemon.
Eat it warm.

title: Spicy lentils
why: Lentils with tomato, onion, garlic, and green chili, eaten with rice.
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer them in water with a pinch of salt until soft.
Warm the oil and soften the onion, the garlic, and the green chili.
Add the tomato, cook until soft, and stir it into the lentils.
Eat it with the rice.

title: Tomato pasta
why: Pasta and tomato with garlic.
steps: Boil the pasta in water with a pinch of salt until tender, then drain it.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Toss the pasta through and eat.

title: Cheese toast
why: Cheese and tomato on toast with butter.
steps: Slice the tomato.
Toast the bread and spread the butter.
Add the cheese and the tomato.
Heat until the cheese softens, then eat.

title: Garlic potato
why: Potato crushed with garlic and oil.
steps: Cut the potato small and boil it in water with a pinch of salt until tender.
Drain it and crush it with a pinch of salt.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Stir the garlic and the oil through the potato and eat.

title: Peas and rice
why: Peas and rice with onion and garlic.
steps: Warm the oil and soften the onion and the garlic.
Add the rice, the peas, a pinch of salt, and enough water to cover.
Simmer until the rice is tender.
Eat it hot.

title: Poha with potato
why: Poha with potato, onion, and lemon.
steps: Dice the potato and the onion small.
Warm the oil, soften the onion, and cook the potato with a pinch of salt and a splash of water until tender.
Rinse the poha, stir it in, and heat it through.
Squeeze the lemon over it and eat.

title: Chickpeas and tomato
why: Chickpeas simmered with tomato, onion, garlic, and ginger.
steps: Warm the oil and soften the onion, the garlic, and the ginger.
Add the tomato and a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Stir in the chickpeas and a splash of water and simmer until thick.
Eat it hot.

title: Green beans with lemon
why: Green beans with garlic, oil, and lemon.
steps: Trim the green beans.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the green beans, a pinch of salt, and a splash of water and cook until just tender.
Squeeze the lemon over them and eat.

title: Capsicum pasta
why: Pasta with capsicum, carrot, tomato, and garlic.
steps: Boil the pasta in water with a pinch of salt until tender, then drain it.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the capsicum, the carrot, and the tomato with a pinch of salt and cook until soft.
Toss the pasta through and eat.

title: Spinach with soy sauce
why: Spinach wilted with garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Rinse the spinach.
Warm the oil and soften the garlic.
Add the spinach and cook until it wilts.
Stir in the soy sauce and eat.

title: Capsicum skillet
why: Capsicum, tomato, onion, garlic, and ginger, cooked until you like them.
steps: Chop the onion, the garlic, the ginger, the capsicum, and the tomato.
Warm the oil and cook the onion, the garlic, and the ginger until they smell sweet.
Add the capsicum and the tomato with a pinch of salt and cook until the texture suits you.
Taste, adjust the salt, and eat.

title: Milk rice
why: Milk and rice, warm, when you want a bowl.
steps: Warm the milk with a splash of water.
Stir in the rice and a pinch of salt.
Heat until the rice is soft.
Eat it warm.

title: Banana yogurt
why: Banana stirred into yogurt. No stove.
steps: Slice the banana.
Stir it into the yogurt.
Add a spoon of water if the yogurt is very thick.
Eat it cold.
